name: Claymation / soft clay look
look: thumbprinted clay, imperfect forms, rim light, 12 fps wobble.

fits.notes: friendly consumer, kids, food, wellness, "human-made" counter to AI slop

when_not: Avoid for dense UI; claymation can't carry readable screens, so show the UI on a clay "device".

type.rule: Style type is for the world's chrome and display; the brand face always sets the real claim line and any product UI text.

colour.guidance: chunky rounded display (Fredoka, Baloo, Recoleta); warm pastels, felt/clay colours, soft shadows.
colour.rule: Style palette fills the world; the brand colour takes the role named in brand_lock.colour_role and never drops below the contrast of the brand's own palette.

keeps: real product UI capture (composited as a screen plate, never redrawn)
brand_lock.colour_role: brand colour is the clay colour of the hero object; rest are warm pastels
brand_lock.type_role: chunky rounded display; the claim in the brand face on a clay device screen
brand_lock.world_changes: clay objects roll in and sculpt themselves; the UI is shown on a clay device prop
brand_lock.rule: Under a brand lock the brand colour, type and logo stay; the style world (material, picture language, motion grammar, finish, sound) is what varies between looks. A branded launch shows 3 different style worlds.

hints: replacement-frame mouth/shape swaps, squash on 2s, fingerprint normal map, held-pose "pop" between poses
objects roll in as lumps and sculpt themselves
motion_grammar.note: grammars lists existing library/grammars ids; grammars_planned lists world grammars the engine plan adds (game-world, tabletop, os-desktop, type-only, editorial, collage, cinematic-world).

effects.role: soft photographic grain over the plates

effects_note: rasan-fx passes (runtime/rasan-fx.js); order is the pass order. {brand_colour} / {second_ink} are filled from the brand or look palette.

codex_assets.prompt_template: claymation {subject}, thumbprinted clay, imperfect forms, soft rim light, smooth-clay look, flat plain green background, 3 variants per pose for boil
codex_assets.r1_note: clay characters/props on green screen, 3 variants per pose for boil; clay UI-device prop; texture tiles.
codex_assets.rules: Flat, evenly lit plain background (chroma green or pure white) for clean cut-outs; one prompt family with the same seed words; generate at 2x and downscale; never ask Codex for readable UI text or logos (typeset them in HTML).

palette: wooden/foley sounds, squishes, tiny glockenspiel, ukulele pluck

build.recipe: `library/motion/stop-motion/stop-motion-aardman-clay.md`, `systems/material/claymation-and-soft-clay.md`. Three.js: MeshPhysicalMaterial with sheen + noise bump + subsurface fake, rendered and stepped at 12 fps by quantising `t`; or 2D: Codex clay plates + A2 + A5 boil.

product_ui_rule: If the film shows RasanAI Studio, use the current dark sidebar UI with the Describe...Final dot stepper (docs/brand/studio-ui/), as a real capture composited INTO this style; never the retired light UI.
